caption: The drawing depicts a single tall stone structure shaped like an obelisk with a rectangular base that slightly tapers upwards. The stone is colored in shades of gray, giving it a textured, rough appearance. At the top of the obelisk is a rounded, turban-like element with grooved, swirling lines. Down the front face, there is a carved relief depicting a cluster of rounded fruits, possibly grapes or pomegranates, and a curved stem or tendril beneath them. There are two small, protruding metal fixtures on each side of the obelisk, one near the top and one near the bottom, appearing to function as brackets or clamps. The background is a plain, off-white color, making the stone structure the focal point of the composition.
title: Gate Post
